request_without_reference_paths.prompt: Create ONE original standalone asset for the SAME knowledge-city strategy-game civilization as the supplied Memory Archive image. Use the image as a strict material and architectural craftsmanship reference, NOT as a silhouette to copy. Warm pale limestone as the main matte mass, broad dark slate ceramic roofs, aged copper-bronze structural eaves and frames with contained turquoise patina, subtle warm amber only in shallow window panes or a tiny lantern. Large calm material regions, warm handcrafted stylized finish, sophisticated proportions rather than medieval fantasy or photorealism. City Dwelling: a compact two-storey stepped limestone studio-home. A slightly broader ground terrace, a smaller upper studio offset toward the rear, generous slate hip roof with substantial copper eaves, and a short copper ridge cap. Windows only as simple shallow framed rectangular recessed panels with thick frames, never perforations or floating grids. Compact architectural base with no surrounding terrain hex, no garden, no chimney, no timber framing, no half-timber, no red clay tiles. Read clearly as a dwelling/atelier, not a guild hall, forum, citadel, temple or tower. Show the complete standalone subject in one clearly ELEVATED THREE-QUARTER ISOMETRIC view, with both front and side visible, all edges inside frame, neutral background and transparent cutout. Readable at small strategy-map scale. All walls and roofs 100% closed. Thick connected structural pieces, no thin railings or filigree, no text, logos, people, gears, dramatic baked shadows, excessive grime, floating pieces or surrounding scenery.
